### What does Beachory do?

platform has also introduced various features such as e-wallets, cancellation and refund facilities,
and the option to book meals and accommodation on trains.

e-catering services. Passengers can pre-book meals and have them delivered to their seats during
their train journey. IRCTC also manages a chain of restaurants under the brand name "Food Plaza" and
"Jan Aahar" across various railway stations in India.

IRCTC also provides tourism services through its website, offering various tour packages and hotel
bookings for destinations across India. The corporation has also introduced various luxury trains,
such as the Maharaja Express and the Buddhist Circuit Tourist Train, which offer a unique travel
experience to passengers

##### IRCTC Tatkal booking

Tatkal refers to emergency tickets. This is necessary when you reserve a train at short notice. At

tickets at reasonable costs. Tatkal tickets are available on a first-come-first-serve basis. With
us, you have a greater chance to get these tickets. You need to book such tickets 24 hours before
the departure of the respective train. You must note, that you cannot get a refund for Tatkal
tickets and these are available only for First Class A/C coaches.

##### IRCTC Ladies quota

The Ladies Quota feature of IRCTC was introduced by IRCTC in 2011. Women who travel alone, or with
kids aged below 3 get a concession on such bookings. You can book tickets in the Ladies Quota on our
portal. In case you are traveling in the sleeper class, you can opt for a Ladies Quota ticket. In a
train, the Ladies Quota has only six booked berths.

# Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort

## Unwind in Aruba's Tropical Paradise

Experience a truly unique stay on the pristine shores of Aruba’s Eagle Beach, consistently ranked
among the best beaches in the Caribbean. At Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, we combine luxurious
accommodations with warm, attentive service that makes every guest feel at home. As a boutique hotel
in Aruba with just 72 rooms, we specialize in personalized hospitality, creating unforgettable
moments through genuine care, welcoming smiles, and exceptional attention to detail.

[ Explore Our Amenities ][4]
[Exterior view of Two Bedroom Suite with surroundings at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]
[Aerail view of the hotel exterior and amenities at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]

The architectural charm of our resort adds a distinctive character to your experience. Surrounded by
lush tropical greenery, our comfortable pool, complete with a cascading waterfall, sets the tone for
a relaxed, tropical rhythm. Step inside, and you'll find Dutch colonial elegance seamlessly blended
with contemporary luxury. Our architecture comes to life through vibrant sunflower yellows and
tranquil sky blues, infusing every corner with a visual charm that creates an ambiance both inviting
and captivating.

These elements embody the very essence of Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, distinguishing us in the
world of hospitality. More than just a hotel, we are a destination where cherished memories are
made, one thoughtful detail at a time. The only thing missing is you. Join us at Amsterdam Manor
Beach Resort to craft your unforgettable Aruba experience.

## Elevate Your Stay: The Penthouse Experience.

Elevate your Aruba escape in our signature Penthouse Suite, where sophistication meets the sea. With
panoramic views of Eagle Beach, spacious living areas, and a private terrace made for Aruba’s
breathtaking sunsets, every moment here feels extraordinary.

Perched above the resort, this Penthouse captures the essence of refined island living in Aruba
where elegant interiors, contemporary design, and the island’s radiant light create an effortless
sense of serenity. Two beautifully appointed bedrooms, a full kitchen, and an expansive living area
open onto a private terrace overlooking the Caribbean.

Whether savoring gentle ocean breezes or toasting beneath Aruba’s star-filled skies, the Penthouse
is where your most unforgettable island memories unfold.

[ Learn More opens in a new tab ][5]

## Honeymoon Suite Aruba

Escape to your private Aruba sanctuary for two, where island elegance meets effortless romance. With
a luxurious king-sized bed, soothing modern design, and a terrace made for sunsets, the Honeymoon
Suite is where unforgettable moments begin.

Nestled in the heart of our Aruba resort, this intimate retreat is designed for connection and calm.
A beautifully appointed bedroom with a spa-inspired bathroom and modern bathtub creates a haven of
relaxation, while the open living and dining area invites quiet moments together.

Enjoy the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen and step onto your private terrace to savor the
warm Aruba breezes as the sun sets over the Caribbean. Every detail ambient lighting, smart TVs,
high-speed WiFi, and advanced air-quality control ensures complete comfort. More than a suite, it’s
where your Aruba love story begins.

[ Begin Your Honeymoon opens in a new tab ][6]

# St. Augustine Beach Bed & Breakfast

Oceanfront Bed & Breakfast beach resort on beautiful St. Augustine Beach. Located just 10 minutes
from the historic town of St. Augustine, our bed and breakfast inn is perfect for adults looking to
get the most out of their stay. St. Augustine, the nation’s oldest city is a special place that’s
rich in history, art and culture. Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is exclusively for-grown-ups.

A romantic **St. Augustine beachfront hotel** that features an unparalleled beachfront location
providing breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean. Known as that special place for honeymooners,
anniversaries, birthdays and special occasions, Beachfront B & B is where dreams come true. When
looking for a **St. Augustine bed & breakfast** that can ensure your stay will be one to remember,
look no further than Beachfront Bed & Breakfast.

[St Augustine Beach House and Pool]

## Oceanfront Accommodations!

The main oceanfront beach house has four rooms and the cottage located behind the beach house has
three rooms. All rooms have a private bathroom. Fine amenities include an outdoor heated pool (open
for swimming when the outdoor temperature is above 62°) and Jacuzzi, award-winning landscaped
gardens and delicious hot, full breakfasts. The Beach House also has a second-floor great room and
oceanfront Verandah with comfortable seating, cookies, coffee, and amazing ocean views. Friendly
ambiance and personalized service are the signature of this** charming bed & breakfast on the
ocean**.

When searching for **hotels in St. Augustine**, you shouldn’t settle for anything less than perfect.
With countless charming rooms to choose from and access to a variety of luxurious amenities,
Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is perfect for couples young and old to fall in love all over again.

for swimming when the outdoor temperature is above 62°) and Jacuzzi, award-winning landscaped
gardens and delicious hot, full breakfasts. The Beach House also has a second-floor great room and
oceanfront Verandah with comfortable seating, cookies, coffee, and amazing ocean views. Friendly
ambiance and personalized service are the signature of this** charming bed & breakfast on the
ocean**.

When searching for **hotels in St. Augustine**, you shouldn’t settle for anything less than perfect.
With countless charming rooms to choose from and access to a variety of luxurious amenities,
Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is perfect for couples young and old to fall in love all over again.

Please note that our property offers limited accessible features at the present time, such as a some
ground floor rooms, however to do more would not be readily achievable given the specifics of the
property.  Please call or email us directly so that we may assist in every way possible.

**Our other rental options:**
* [La Fiesta Ocean Inn & Suites][114]– For families, couples, and girlfriend getaways. Located one
  block away from Beachfront Bed & Breakfast, with a private boardwalk to the beach.

**House and Cottage Rentals – all within a block of the ocean and Beachfront Bed & Breakfast:**
* [View all six of of house and cottage rentals][115]
* [Oceanfront Beach House – Newly Renovated & Furnished][116] 2 bedroom, 2 bath, pet-friendly.
  Sleeps up to 6.
* [Luxurious 3-story ocean view private home][117] with elevator, rooftop ocean view deck, and
  private heated pool. Sleeps up to 10.
* [Beachside Magnificent Estate Family Home][118] – Incredible ocean view, private heated pool.
  Sleeps up to 11.
* [Pet-friendly 2nd floor, ocean facing 2 bedroom unit][119] with large kitchen, balcony with
  partial ocean view. Sleeps 4.
* [Sand Dollar East Cottage][120] – Ground floor one bedroom pet-friendly cottage rental, very close
  to the beach
* [Sand Dollar West Cottage][121] – Ground floor one bedroom pet-friendly cottage rental, very close
  to the beach

## Florida Beach Getaway

The intimate setting of this exclusive bed & breakfast inn lends itself to a truly enjoyable and
memorable experience. Stunning ocean views, tranquil atmosphere and spectacular sunrises make this
the perfect romantic hideaway. Relax and enjoy the heated pool (open for swimming when the outdoor
temperature is above 62°), large outdoor Jacuzzi, and oversized hammock for two that beckons for
couples to relax and unwind on over two acres of lush, oceanfront property that is quiet & relaxing
and just for grown-ups. It’s a great place when you are looking for a hotel in St. Augustine, FL.

Looking to have deluxe beach chairs and an umbrella set up and waiting for you in the sand each
morning? This is possible with Barney’s Beach Service. Click [here][122] for details. B

[Start Your Beach Journey][33]

The United States has over 23 coastal states with thousands of unique beaches—from the white sands
of Florida's Gulf Coast to rugged cliffs in Oregon. Whether you're chasing waves, looking for family
activities, or searching for hidden gems, Beachory brings you verified, up-to-date beach info.

Beachory: Quick FAQs

### What does Beachory do?

Beachory helps you plan smarter beach trips with practical, decision-ready info: **parking**,
**entrances**, **restrooms**, accessibility notes, and clear maps. You can also browse curated
collections like [Family-friendly][34], [Surfing][35], [Sunrise][36], [Sunset][37], and [Best for
Photos][38]. Think of Beachory as a focused beach guide that saves time and avoids surprises.

### How should I search for beaches?

Start with a **state** or **city**, then refine by the experience you want. You can jump into hubs
like [Florida beaches][39], [California beaches][40], or [Maryland beaches][41]. We keep internal
links *stable* for SEO and reliability—only clean parameters like state/city/experience/page; we
never put volatile latitude/longitude or tracking params in crawlable links.

### What will I find on a beach page?

A beach page summarizes what matters most before you go: where to park, how to reach the **closest
entrance**, what **amenities** exist (restrooms, showers, lifeguards, food nearby), accessibility
notes, photos, maps, and community tips. When available, we also include vibe/context—crowds, family
suitability, or photo spots—so you can set expectations and plan the best time to visit.

### Parking: what should I expect and how do I avoid hassles?

Beach parking rules can vary by city and season. Look for details on whether lots are **free or
paid**, if there’s time-limited street parking, and whether payment apps or permits are required.
When lots fill early on weekends, consider arriving before mid-morning or [Aerial view of a sandy beach with turquoise water]

paid**, if there’s time-limited street parking, and whether payment apps or permits are required.
When lots fill early on weekends, consider arriving before mid-morning or target weekday afternoons.
Always check signs on arrival and avoid blocking driveways or emergency access—tickets near popular
beaches can be costly.

### Accessibility: which beaches are easier with strollers or wheelchairs?

We highlight **stroller and wheelchair access** wherever possible—boardwalks, beach mats, ramps, and
accessible restrooms make a big difference. If mobility is a priority, prefer beaches with paved or
hard-packed paths, close-in parking, and lifeguard stations that list accessibility notes. You can
also filter by family-friendly amenities and look for on-map entrance markers located near
facilities.

### Safety: lifeguards, flags, rip currents, and basic precautions?

If you plan to swim, choose beaches with **lifeguards** and check local flag systems on arrival.
Avoid rip currents by swimming near guards, staying within your depth, and learning escape
techniques (swim parallel to shore to exit a rip). Give extra space during surf days or strong
winds, and keep kids within arm’s reach when waves pick up. When in doubt, ask lifeguards—they’re
the best local resource.

### When is the best time to visit: crowds, seasons, and conditions?

Crowds swell on sunny weekend middays. For a calmer experience, try **early mornings**, weekdays, or
shoulder seasons. If you’re after golden-hour photos, check our [Sunrise][42] and [Sunset][43]
lists. In shoulder months, water can be cooler and some amenities limited—packing layers, snacks,
and a backup plan helps.

### Pets: what should I know before bringing my dog?

Pet rules change by city and season—some beaches allow dogs on-leash during specific hours, others
restrict access during nesting seasons. Check signage on arrival, bring fresh water, and keep waste
bags handy. To find easier options, look for **Pet-friendly** indicators and consider less busy
times so your dog can adjust calmly.

Kuala Lumpur
[Kuala Lumpur]
Malaysia vibrant capital – Kuala Lumpur is packed with historic monuments, steel-clad skyscrapers,
lush parks, mega-sized shopping malls, bustling street markets, trendy nightspots, and famous
hawker-type eateries. With abundance of thrills and delights everywhere to be discovered, embark on

[explore][99]
Johor Bahru
[Johor Bahru]
Johor Bahru, the southernmost state in Malaysia, is a vibrant city neighbouring Singapore. It boasts
integrated developments and tourist attractions, including Legoland Malaysia and Puteri Harbour.
This bustling metropolis also serves as a thriving commercial hub and a popular stopover for
travellers commuting between Malaysia and Singapore.
[explore][100]
Penang
[Penang]
Experience a harmonious blend of tradition, modernity, and nature in Penang. Known as the ‘Pearl of
the Orient’ and hailed as the food capital of Malaysia, this enchanting island destination entices
travellers with its rich heritage, stunning coastlines, and mouth-watering street food. Wander
through the streets of George Town, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage site, and discover wonders
at every turn.
[explore][101]
Langkawi
[Langkawi]
Langkawi, often referred to as the ‘Jewel of Kedah’, comprises an archipelago of 99 islands. In
2007, this legendary destination earned the UNESCO Global Geopark status. From ancient rock
formations to a treasure trove of flora and fauna, the Langkawi Geopark experience is an absolute
must for nature enthusiasts. Langkawi is also a duty-free island – the perfect retreat for savvy
shoppers.
[explore][102]
Tioman
[Tioman]
Nestled in the South China Sea, Tioman Island boasts breathtaking mountains, pristine beaches, and a
marine environment of unparalleled beauty. Teeming with vibrant coral reefs, this tropical haven has
rightfully earned its status as one of the world’s top diving destinations, offering exhilarating
underwater adventures. Whether you're a nature lover or a thrill seeker, Tioman Island guarantees an
unforgettable getaway.

We have been operating for 42 years and are the longest-running eco tour company in New Zealand. We
are a Net Carbon Zero certified company who have won many awards including Best Small Tourism
Company in New Zealand. Bush and Beach is a small family owned company who are leaders in
sustainable tourism and are proud of our sustainability commitment which you can find [here][66].
Some of the money from your booking goes straight back into local environmental initiatives.

With our small group tour sizes and knowledgeable and experienced guides you will have plenty of
opportunities to ask questions and find out what you want to know. We will look after you in our
small comfortable air conditioned vehicles with plenty of legroom.

Free Cancellation policy – You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the booked tour for a full
refund – [learn more][67]

Our office staff can help you with any [enquiries][68] you might have and help you choose the tour
that’s right for you. We will reconfirm all tours with you the day before so you don’t  have to
worry about pick up times.  Bush and Beach work closely with the Auckland hotels and offer **pick up
and drop offs from your Auckland City Centre hotel** for all of our Auckland day tours.

Exceptional Experiences by Exceptional People

A global leader in experiential tourism and resort services.

Meet RED Hospitality & Leisure

RED Hospitality & Leisure is a global leader in Resort, Eco- Tourism and Destination Services and
operator of world-class watersports brands across the Caribbean, South Florida and Hawaii.

[Contact us ][17]
[DJI_20230915101534_0389_D.jpg]

R

### Resort Services

RED provides critical guest facing services and outsourcing to luxury and lifestyle resorts
including concierge, beach and pool desk service, non-motorized watersports, marina management,
ground transportation, ferry services and boutique retail

[Grace-Bay-Club-221.jpg]

E

### Ecotourism

RED owns and operates world-class watersports and excursion brands across its markets and seamlessly
integrates them with our resort and cruise partners. RED sets the global standard offering unique,
high quality and safe experiences across our fleet

[_MG_6018.jpg]

D

### Destination Services

RED counts some of the worlds best hospitality brands among its customer and has the privilege of
serving as the on-property DMC to several luxury resorts and destination. RED's unique, vertically
integrated approach allows us to provide in-house, turn-key solutions to groups of all sizes and
needs with an unprecedented level of service and customer accountability

Discover Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily: three extraordinary destinations where the sea meets
history, authentic flavors, and dreamlike landscapes. From pristine beaches to crystal-clear waters,
from charming villages to the most authentic traditions, every corner of Italy offers unique
emotions and unforgettable moments. Let yourself be captivated by the warmth of hospitality, the
aromas of Mediterranean cuisine, and the magic of timeless lands. Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily
await you for an authentic, intense, and surprising experience.

# Katathani Phuket Beach Resort

Kata Noi Beach, Phuket, Thailand

Welcome to Katathani Phuket Beach Resort, a deluxe beachfront sanctuary set along an 850-meter
stretch of pristine white sand on Kata Noi Beach, Phuket, Thailand. Nestled where lush green hills
gracefully embrace the sparkling blue ocean, the resort radiates tranquility and natural
beauty-perfectly embodying the spirit of Phuket.

Designed to ensure your perfect experience, the resort offers distinct wings tailored to every
traveler - whether you're venturing solo, seeking a romantic escape, or planning a family getaway.
This exquisite Phuket retreat provides everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Immerse
yourself in world-class amenities, rejuvenate with soothing spa treatments, and savor exquisite
dining options, all while basking in the serene allure of Phuket’s most idyllic settings along a
stunning public beach.

Vhari Wing Bhuri Wing

# [Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa][16]

**Welcome to Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa**

Surround yourself with nature and at this tranquil retreat in north Phuket and appreciate the real
beauty of this paradise island away from the bustling tourist crowds. Situated on the fringes of
Sirinat National Park there is an abundance of greenery area, and the beautiful beach with gently
sloping white sand is just a few steps away.

**Nai Yang Beach Resort** is located in a quiet bay on the northwest coast of Phuket Island. Guests
can enjoy comfortable rooms, a spa center, and an outdoor swimming pool. The rooms offer beautiful
views of the tropical landscape. Free parking is available for guests.

Nai Yang Beach Resort is only 1 km from Phuket International Airport. It takes no more than 5
minutes to walk to the sandy beaches.

The rooms at Nai Yang Resort are decorated in a modern style and equipped with air conditioning.
Each room has a private balcony overlooking the lush garden and the pool. Other standard amenities
include tea/coffee making facilities and a cable TV.

The tour desk can assist guests in booking one-day island excursions. Laundry services are also
available.

At **Turtle Bay Restaurant**, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring international cuisine,
while **The Sand Restaurant** offers a variety of Thai and Western dishes.

# [Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa][16]

**Welcome to Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa**

Surround yourself with nature and at this tranquil retreat in north Phuket and appreciate the real
beauty of this paradise island away from the bustling tourist crowds. Situated on the fringes of
Sirinat National Park there is an abundance of greenery area, and the beautiful beach with gently
sloping white sand is just a few steps away.

**Nai Yang Beach Resort** is located in a quiet bay on the northwest coast of Phuket Island. Guests
can enjoy comfortable rooms, a spa center, and an outdoor swimming pool. The rooms offer beautiful
views of the tropical landscape. Free parking is available for guests.

Nai Yang Beach Resort is only 1 km from Phuket International Airport. It takes no more than 5
minutes to walk to the sandy beaches.

The rooms at Nai Yang Resort are decorated in a modern style and equipped with air conditioning.
Each room has a private balcony overlooking the lush garden and the pool. Other standard amenities
include tea/coffee making facilities and a cable TV.

The tour desk can assist guests in booking one-day island excursions. Laundry services are also
available.

At **Turtle Bay Restaurant**, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring international cuisine,
while **The Sand Restaurant** offers a variety of Thai and Western dishes.

[Learn more][17]

# WELCOME TO NEW YORK CITY

There's no time like the present to plan a trip to New York City, with its constant energy and
endless supply of sights, attractions and activities. Don't wait—a second spent in NYC is just too
valuable to miss.

## FROM TIMES SQUARE TO THE WORLD

Our video series follows New Yorkers around the boroughs as they uncover NYC's groundbreaking
cultural movements, creative cuisines and revolutionary ideas—starting right from Times Square. See
the trailer below, and

[**watch the full series here**][7]
.


## ABOUT THE FIVE BOROUGHS

[EXPLORE THE BOROUGHS][8]

So what’s a “borough,” anyway? It’s like a smaller city within our massive metropolis. New York City
has five of them.

### Staten Island

New York City’s southernmost borough is filled with historic attractions, beach views and global
dining options—all just a ferry ride away.

[View Borough][9]

### The Bronx

The Bronx is packed with New York City history and culture. It’s where Babe Ruth became a baseball
legend, where the sounds and styles of hip-hop were born and where you can feast on old-world
classics in its own Little Italy.

[View Borough][10]

### Brooklyn

Between its world-class nightlife and boundary-pushing cuisine, Brooklyn has earned an enviable
reputation, but make no mistake—there's fun to be had for all ages.

[View Borough][11]

### Manhattan

From the bright lights of Broadway to the soaring elms of Central Park and beyond, Manhattan is an
American icon. With the most recognizable skyline in the world, NYC’s most visited borough is full
of excitement for every kind of adventurer.

[View Borough][12]

### Queens

Queens can satisfy nearly every taste and thrill. From an endless selection of old-world cuisines to
the scenic surf, it’s easy to explore the entire world in one trip around this borough.

[View Borough][13]

# Home

## We’re On the Beach

On the Beach Group plc is one of the UK’s largest online package holiday specialists. We offer
choice, value, flexibility and financial protection, powered by our proprietary technology platform.

With an asset-light, cash-generative model, we drive customer acquisition and loyalty through
scalable technology, automation and operational efficiency, enabling us to grow profitably while
helping more people holiday better and more often.

Renowned for beach package holidays, we have leveraged our expertise, technology and strong supplier
relationships to broaden our addressable market, expanding into city breaks and cruise holidays, and
offering our full range of holidays to customers in the Republic of Ireland.

# Home

## We’re On the Beach

On the Beach Group plc is one of the UK’s largest online package holiday specialists. We offer
choice, value, flexibility and financial protection, powered by our proprietary technology platform.

With an asset-light, cash-generative model, we drive customer acquisition and loyalty through
scalable technology, automation and operational efficiency, enabling us to grow profitably while
helping more people holiday better and more often.

Renowned for beach package holidays, we have leveraged our expertise, technology and strong supplier
relationships to broaden our addressable market, expanding into city breaks and cruise holidays, and
offering our full range of holidays to customers in the Republic of Ireland.

### The Resort

Accor is a world-leading augmented hospitality group offering unique experiences in more than 5,100
hotels & residences across 110 destinations. The Group has acquired hospitality expertise for over
50 years, resulting in an unrivaled portfolio of 39 hotel brands, from luxury to economy. The Group
also offers digital solutions that maximize distribution, optimize hotel operations & enhance the
customer experience.

With [**ALL – Accor Live Limitless**][61], the new daily lifestyle companion, the relationship
between the Group & our clients, members & partners evolves from transactional to emotional &
unlocks the potential to live, work & play. Beyond accommodation, ALL enables new ways to live, work
& play by blending food & beverage with nightlife, wellbeing & co-working.

Accor is deeply committed to sustainable value creation & plays an active role in giving back to the
planet & community via its **Sustainability** program & the **Accor Solidarity** endowment fund,
which gives disadvantaged groups access to employment through professional training.

[**Pullman Hotels & Resorts**][62] set a new tempo in global travel & living, delivering an
inspiring, energizing & enriching experience to new entrepreneurs. Pullman welcomes guests with the
space to focus, work & play. Forward-thinking, hyper-connected & passionate about art & fitness,
Pullman retains the adventurous spirit & open-minded ambition that drove it to become a pioneering
travel brand over 150 years ago. Today Pullman features more than 130 properties in vibrant &
cosmopolitan destinations around the world.

## PULLMAN DANANG BEACH RESORT

 




##### Pullman Danang Beach Resort is part of Accor, a world-leading augmented hospitality group
##### offering unique experiences in more than 5,000 hotels & residences across 110 countries.

 

Central Vietnam’s silver shores provide seaside fun for your holiday. And the up-and-coming city of
Da Nang is your urban playground, just waiting to be explored. On the stunning white sands of Bac My
An Beach, **Pullman Danang Beach Resort** is a vibrant oasis of activity & relaxation. Distinctive
cuisine & creative beverage concepts are Pullman hallmarks.

### IDYLLIC LOCATION

 


Set on the white sands of Bac My An Beach, overlooking the azure waters of the East Sea, **Pullman
Danang Beach Resort** is the ultimate tropical paradise. Only 15 minutes from Danang International
Airport & the city center, and just a short drive from world-class golf courses, our premium resort
is perfectly positioned for all types of travelers. With several UNESCO World Heritage sites on its
doorstep, Pullman Danang Beach Resort is the ideal start to explore the region’s abundance of
natural beauty & cultural significance.

### **ELEGANTLY APPOINTED ROOMS & CREATIVE CULINARY CONCEPTS**

 

**Pullman Danang Beach Resort** features 186 elegantly appointed guest [**rooms & cottages**][63],
all with private balconies overlooking the beach, infinity pool, or tropical gardens.

#### Before 2000: Local Boat Dock

Before developing into a maritime transportation hub, Rassada Pier was merely a small dock used for
fishing boats and local cargo vessels. The area was just an ordinary coastline with minimal
infrastructure, supporting fishermen and traders between islands.

#### 2005–2010: Expansion

Islands ][25] and other islands.

expansions to [Koh Lanta][26] and [Railay Beach][27].

dramatically declining.

4-star coastal luxury in Surfers Paradise with stunning ocean views

### Accommodation

Rhapsody Resort offers stylish self-contained accommodation in Surfers Paradise. Guests can choose
between studio, one, or two-bedroom apartments with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and city
skyline. Each apartment includes a full kitchen and laundry facilities for added convenience.

### Facilities

The hotel includes a rooftop garden terrace on Level 41, providing panoramic views of the Gold
Coast. A 20-metre heated outdoor swimming pool, spa, steam room, and sauna are available to guests
for relaxation. A fully equipped gym on Level 27 offers scenic views during workouts.

### Dining Options

The Rhapsody Beachside Café on the ground level serves organic fair trade coffee and a varied menu
featuring fresh seasonal dishes. Guests can enjoy casual dining just steps from Surfers Paradise
Beach. Outdoor BBQ facilities are available for guests wishing to cook and dine al fresco.

### Location

Situated just 100 metres from patrolled Surfers Paradise Beach, Rhapsody Resort is in close
proximity to local restaurants and retail options. The hotel is an ideal base for exploring the Gold
Coast and its many attractions, including theme parks and hidden beachfronts. Public transport is
easily accessible, enhancing convenience for guests.

### Event Spaces

The hotel offers two meeting rooms on Level 27, suitable for small corporate events and gatherings.
Both spaces feature modern amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi and adjoining balcony access with
ocean views. These rooms can accommodate groups ranging from 6 to 50 guests.

Wellness: heated outdoor pool, spa, sauna

Dining: Rhapsody Beachside Café

Event Spaces: meeting rooms on Level 27

# Welcome to San Juan, Puerto Rico
# 2026 Tourism Guide

[🇵🇷 Puerto Rico][72] ⎮ San Juan – Capital of Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico - Best of Tourism Travel Guide - 2024]

### **San Juan, Where Old World Elegance & Modern Caribbean Meet to Create the Most Vibrant and
### Romantic Destination in the Caribbean.**

#### Save a Spot - Top Culebra Day Trip from San Juan


Welcome to San Juan, the capital city of **[Puerto Rico][73]**, where Old World elegance, modern
luxuries, and tropical allure come together to offer unforgettable experiences like no other
destination.   Swim, [snorkel][74], surf, and relax at [San Juan’s beaches][75], explore the
historic and romantic district of [Old San Juan][76], and immerse yourself in the vibrant
[culture][77].  Whether you’re honeymooning, a solo traveler, a young family, or young at heart, San
Juan will deliver extraordinary experiences.

Go on a number of exciting [day trips from San Juan][78], such as exploring the [*El Yunque
Rainforest*][79], seeing the magic of the [bioluminescent bays][80], [sailing to secluded
islands][81], beach hopping to stunning beaches, exploring world-class [caves][82], going on[
off-road adventures][83], [ziplining][84], and much more.

## Experience Two Distinct Exciting Destinations

The Romance of European Charm & A Modern Tropical City

## Old San Juan / El Viejo San Juan

[[Old San Juan, Puerto Rico]][85]

[Old San Juan (*El Viejo San Juan*)][86] is the most beloved town in Puerto Rico by both locals and
visitors; you’ll feel like you’re in a European city, but more intimate, colorful, and certainly
livelier.  We invite you to make Old San Juan your first stop in Puerto Rico.  Wear comfortable
shoes; you’ll

### Read more

… want to walk every block leading to five-century-old forts, museums, cathedrals, elegant squares,
romantic promenades, delightful restaurants, and one-of-a-kind shops.  Immerse yourself in our
vibrant culture by joining the festive events celebrated throughout the year.  For honeymooners, the
Old City unfolds romantic experiences and quiet spots to cherish moments of love. Get lost in the
allure of this historic gem and create memories that linger in the heart.

[About Old San Juan][87] ⎮ [Hotels in Old San Juan][88] ⎮ [Old San Juan Tours][89]

## The New San Juan

[San Juan Puerto Rico]

Discover the ever-evolving “New San Juan,” the vibrant metropolis of the Caribbean that seamlessly
blends modernity with tropical allures.  Our capital city presents a dynamic fusion of urban
amenities and lively entertainment, complemented by the enchantment of tropical beaches…

### Read more

… lavish beachfront hotels, excellent dining options, shopping extravagance, and exhilarating
nightlife.  Explore the tourist hotspots of Condado, Ocean Park, and nearby Isla Verde, where you
can revel in the best of both worlds — experience the energy of bustling city life and unwind in the
true spirit of a fun and relaxing tropical escape.

### **San Juan, Where Old World Elegance & Modern Caribbean Meet to Create the Most Vibrant and
### Romantic Destination in the Caribbean.**

#### Save a Spot - Top Culebra Day Trip from San Juan


Welcome to San Juan, the capital city of **[Puerto Rico][73]**, where Old World elegance, modern
luxuries, and tropical allure come together to offer unforgettable experiences like no other
destination.   Swim, [snorkel][74], surf, and relax at [San Juan’s beaches][75], explore the
historic and romantic district of [Old San Juan][76], and immerse yourself in the vibrant
[culture][77].  Whether you’re honeymooning, a solo traveler, a young family, or young at heart, San
Juan will deliver extraordinary experiences.

Go on a number of exciting [day trips from San Juan][78], such as exploring the [*El Yunque
Rainforest*][79], seeing the magic of the [bioluminescent bays][80], [sailing to secluded
islands][81], beach hopping to stunning beaches, exploring world-class [caves][82], going on[
off-road adventures][83], [ziplining][84], and much more.

The Romance of European Charm & A Modern Tropical City

## Old San Juan / El Viejo San Juan

[[Old San Juan, Puerto Rico]][85]

[Old San Juan (*El Viejo San Juan*)][86] is the most beloved town in Puerto Rico by both locals and
visitors; you’ll feel like you’re in a European city, but more intimate, colorful, and certainly
livelier.  We invite you to make Old San Juan your first stop in Puerto Rico.  Wear comfortable
shoes; you’ll

romantic promenades, delightful restaurants, and one-of-a-kind shops.  Immerse yourself in our
vibrant culture by joining the festive events celebrated throughout the year.  For honeymooners, the
Old City unfolds romantic experiences and quiet spots to cherish moments of love. Get lost in the
allure of this historic gem and create memories that linger in the heart.

## The New San Juan

[San Juan Puerto Rico]

Discover the ever-evolving “New San Juan,” the vibrant metropolis of the Caribbean that seamlessly
blends modernity with tropical allures.  Our capital city presents a dynamic fusion of urban
amenities and lively entertainment, complemented by the enchantment of tropical beaches…

true spirit of a fun and relaxing tropical escape. 

Take a few minutes to learn more about the **[Best Tourist Spots to Stay in San Juan][90]** that fit
your travel preferences.  

## Tourism in San Juan, Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico 2023 - Tourism Guide]

Five centuries ago, San Juan was an impenetrable walled city; today, it is a hassle-free and
exciting tropical escape in the Caribbean, welcoming visitors with open arms.  San Juan is the most
popular tourist destination in Puerto Rico and a bustling cruise port in the Caribbean, giving
visitors world-class attractions, fun activities, and rich cultural experiences easily accessible,
so no precious vacation time is wasted.  

[Getting around San Juan][91] to enjoy it all is easy; no car rental is needed; you can walk to many
places, take a taxi or Uber, or enjoy scenic bicycle rides around the city.

### + Key Facts for Visitors
* If you’re a U.S. Citizen, there is no passport requirement; it is like traveling to another
  state. 
* There is no need to travel far; the average flight from many US city airports is just 3.5 hours. 
* Spanish and English are the official languages, and most of the staff in the tourism industry are
  bilingual. 
* No car rental is needed to explore and enjoy the city of San Juan. 
* Outside of the city, you can explore the natural wonders and fun things to do around the island;
  visitors can book tours with friendly professional guides or rent a car to explore at their own
  pace.

Sunny Isles Beach is an ideal destination for both leisure and business travelers. With pristine
beaches, endless sunshine, and crystal-clear waters, it’s perfect for relaxation or adventure,
offering jet skiing, parasailing, and paddleboarding. Just minutes away, Aventura Mall boasts one of
the largest luxury shopping experiences in the U.S., while the Ancient Spanish Monastery offers a
unique cultural stop with lush gardens and historical charm.

# Get Beach Ready!

### The Beach Company serves as an inclusive, one-stop shop for holiday and resort wear for the
### entire family. We offer an extensive range of clothing and accessories, including: Swimwear
### (one-piece swimsuits, bikinis, monokinis), stylish cover-ups (kaftans, sarongs), and beachwear.
### For men, Swim shorts, board shorts, and linen shirts. And not forget the kids - from swimwear to

## About us

We are a **group of friends** fascinated by the beauties of the United States. We love to explore
them far and wide, always seeking out the most stunning and surprising attractions that this vast
country has to offer. Our favorite way to explore them is through **road trips**, for the sense of
freedom and adventure it provides, and because it enables us to discover new destinations and hidden
gems, often far from the most popular tourist spots and mass tourism.

However, we also don’t shy away from more traditional and focused trips, perhaps centered around
visiting individual cities or more specific areas. **Our mission** is to explore all of the United
States… and then start all over again! An impossible mission, an endless journey that, precisely
because of the unattainable goal, motivates us every day to ask ourselves: what is there to discover
anew today?

The main contributors to **Travel in USA** are [Lorenzo Puliti][52], [Filippo Nardelli][53], and
[Bernardo Pacini][54] (currently partners at the [Evenit][55] company), but there are many other
tireless travelers who assist us in this adventure, contributing firsthand with their **travel
accounts**. To learn more, explore our [editorial team][56]. To find out more about our history and

## About us

We are a **group of friends** fascinated by the beauties of the United States. We love to explore
them far and wide, always seeking out the most stunning and surprising attractions that this vast
country has to offer. Our favorite way to explore them is through **road trips**, for the sense of
freedom and adventure it provides, and because it enables us to discover new destinations and hidden
gems, often far from the most popular tourist spots and mass tourism.

However, we also don’t shy away from more traditional and focused trips, perhaps centered around
visiting individual cities or more specific areas. **Our mission** is to explore all of the United
States… and then start all over again! An impossible mission, an endless journey that, precisely
because of the unattainable goal, motivates us every day to ask ourselves: what is there to discover
anew today?

The main contributors to **Travel in USA** are [Lorenzo Puliti][52], [Filippo Nardelli][53], and
[Bernardo Pacini][54] (currently partners at the [Evenit][55] company), but there are many other
tireless travelers who assist us in this adventure, contributing firsthand with their **travel
accounts**. To learn more, explore our [editorial team][56]. To find out more about our history and
how to contact us, click the button below:

## Discover the Charm of Vietnam

Step into the magical world of Vietnam!
A land where timeless beauty meets warm hospitality.
Enjoy our favourable visa policies including bilateral visa exemptions for selected countries,
45-day unilateral visa-free access for travellers from 24 nations and exclusive waivers for
celebrities and distinguished guests. For longer journeys, visitors can easily obtain 90-day e-visa
available for all nationalities, making entry smoother and more accessible.
A network of convenient direct international flights whisks you away to this mesmerizing
destination, where every journey begins effortlessly. Immerse yourself in pristine beaches and
idyllic islands, explore ancient treasures and UNESCO wonders, marvel at breathtaking landscapes,
savour legendary cuisine, and celebrate with vibrant festivals alive with tradition.
Vietnam invites you to create unforgettable stories, where every moment is a celebration of beauty,
culture, and adventure. Your extraordinary Vietnamese journey awaits - come, be enchanted!

## Discover the Charm of Vietnam

Step into the magical world of Vietnam!
A land where timeless beauty meets warm hospitality.
Enjoy our favourable visa policies including bilateral visa exemptions for selected countries,
45-day unilateral visa-free access for travellers from 24 nations and exclusive waivers for
celebrities and distinguished guests. For longer journeys, visitors can easily obtain 90-day e-visa
available for all nationalities, making entry smoother and more accessible.
A network of convenient direct international flights whisks you away to this mesmerizing
destination, where every journey begins effortlessly. Immerse yourself in pristine beaches and
idyllic islands, explore ancient treasures and UNESCO wonders, marvel at breathtaking landscapes,
savour legendary cuisine, and celebrate with vibrant festivals alive with tradition.
Vietnam invites you to create unforgettable stories, where every moment is a celebration of beauty,
culture, and adventure. Your extraordinary Vietnamese journey awaits - come, be enchanted!

# Pura Vida

## Bienvenido a Costa Rica

Costa Rica is the land of pura vida. Take the quiz to discover your traveler type—and where your
journey begins.

## About Costa Rica

### An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is
your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning
undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors
from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and
entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high
number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and
integrated health care practices.

[Snorkeling adventure caribbean]
Costa Rica regions

## Caribbean


An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of
Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

[ explore the region ][45]

[A bird's eye view of a beach and a body of water]

## Central Pacific


Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central
Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

[ explore the region ][46]

## Central Valley


Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and
delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

## Guanacaste


Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from
tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

Arenal Volcano towers over protected forests and heats natural hot springs. Rivers and waterfalls
flow through landscapes that look like fairy-tale settings.

Puntarenas is one of the most popular tourism regions, loved for its coastline dotted with inlets

A Real *Vibe.*
[Experience Long Beach with the Vibe City Pass][50]
CREDIT: Lucas Gordon Photography

# Catch a real vibe

Long Beach has a feeling you notice as soon as you arrive. It's real, it's warm, it's creative...
It's a vibe.

From Retro Row to Brewery Knolls, SoCal's largest Aquarium, a historic ocean liner and so much more,
local experts have you covered with the best spots to eat, play and stay.

[View Expert Insights & Local Stories][51]
[FIFA World Cup 2026™][52]
Long Beach is your gateway to the FIFA World Cup 2026™ experience you've been dreaming about.
[Learn More][53]
[LA28 Olympics in Long Beach][54]
Long Beach is a premier destination for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosting eight major
athletic events during the games–the most of any city other than Los Angeles. With the city’s
stunning coastline providing the setting and an Olympic legacy that dates back to the 1932 Games,
Long Beach offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience the world’s biggest sporting event
up close.
[Learn More][55]

# Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort

## Unwind in Aruba's Tropical Paradise

Experience a truly unique stay on the pristine shores of Aruba’s Eagle Beach, consistently ranked
among the best beaches in the Caribbean. At Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, we combine luxurious
accommodations with warm, attentive service that makes every guest feel at home. As a boutique hotel
in Aruba with just 72 rooms, we specialize in personalized hospitality, creating unforgettable
moments through genuine care, welcoming smiles, and exceptional attention to detail.

[ Explore Our Amenities ][4]
[Exterior view of Two Bedroom Suite with surroundings at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]
[Aerail view of the hotel exterior and amenities at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]

The architectural charm of our resort adds a distinctive character to your experience. Surrounded by
lush tropical greenery, our comfortable pool, complete with a cascading waterfall, sets the tone for
a relaxed, tropical rhythm. Step inside, and you'll find Dutch colonial elegance seamlessly blended
with contemporary luxury. Our architecture comes to life through vibrant sunflower yellows and
tranquil sky blues, infusing every corner with a visual charm that creates an ambiance both inviting
and captivating.

These elements embody the very essence of Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, distinguishing us in the
world of hospitality. More than just a hotel, we are a destination where cherished memories are
made, one thoughtful detail at a time. The only thing missing is you. Join us at Amsterdam Manor
Beach Resort to craft your unforgettable Aruba experience.

## Elevate Your Stay: The Penthouse Experience.

Elevate your Aruba escape in our signature Penthouse Suite, where sophistication meets the sea. With
panoramic views of Eagle Beach, spacious living areas, and a private terrace made for Aruba’s
breathtaking sunsets, every moment here feels extraordinary.

Perched above the resort, this Penthouse captures the essence of refined island living in Aruba
where elegant interiors, contemporary design, and the island’s radiant light create an effortless
sense of serenity. Two beautifully appointed bedrooms, a full kitchen, and an expansive living area
open onto a private terrace overlooking the Caribbean.

Whether savoring gentle ocean breezes or toasting beneath Aruba’s star-filled skies, the Penthouse
is where your most unforgettable island memories unfold.

[ Learn More opens in a new tab ][5]

## Honeymoon Suite Aruba

Escape to your private Aruba sanctuary for two, where island elegance meets effortless romance. With
a luxurious king-sized bed, soothing modern design, and a terrace made for sunsets, the Honeymoon
Suite is where unforgettable moments begin.

Nestled in the heart of our Aruba resort, this intimate retreat is designed for connection and calm.
A beautifully appointed bedroom with a spa-inspired bathroom and modern bathtub creates a haven of
relaxation, while the open living and dining area invites quiet moments together.

Enjoy the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen and step onto your private terrace to savor the
warm Aruba breezes as the sun sets over the Caribbean. Every detail ambient lighting, smart TVs,
high-speed WiFi, and advanced air-quality control ensures complete comfort. More than a suite, it’s
where your Aruba love story begins.

[ Begin Your Honeymoon opens in a new tab ][6]

where elegant interiors, contemporary design, and the island’s radiant light create an effortless
sense of serenity. Two beautifully appointed bedrooms, a full kitchen, and an expansive living area
open onto a private terrace overlooking the Caribbean.

Whether savoring gentle ocean breezes or toasting beneath Aruba’s star-filled skies, the Penthouse
is where your most unforgettable island memories unfold.

Escape to your private Aruba sanctuary for two, where island elegance meets effortless romance. With
a luxurious king-sized bed, soothing modern design, and a terrace made for sunsets, the Honeymoon
Suite is where unforgettable moments begin.

Nestled in the heart of our Aruba resort, this intimate retreat is designed for connection and calm.
A beautifully appointed bedroom with a spa-inspired bathroom and modern bathtub creates a haven of
relaxation, while the open living and dining area invites quiet moments together.

Enjoy the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen and step onto your private terrace to savor the
warm Aruba breezes as the sun sets over the Caribbean. Every detail ambient lighting, smart TVs,
high-speed WiFi, and advanced air-quality control ensures complete comfort. More than a suite, it’s
where your Aruba love story begins.

# Proudly powering Australian tourism.

ATDW is Australia’s central digital platform for tourism. We connect the tourism community so every
business is visible, every traveller can find the best Australian experiences, and the whole
industry grows stronger together.

[
Get started

## Connecting everyone.

Every corner of the tourism community can connect to our platform and unlock unique benefits.
Whether you’re a tourism business looking to boost bookings, a distributor in search of rich
content, or a destination focused on regional growth, ATDW is here to support your success.

[

### tourism businesses

Get your business featured on Australia’s most influential tourism sites with one easy listing.
Reach more customers, drive bookings, and enjoy expert support every step of the way.

Learn more

### distributors

profiles, helping you deliver trusted Australian experiences that keep your users coming back for
more.

### destinations

from a simple solution that drives real economic growth, without stretching your resources.

Learn more

ATDW is more than just a platform—it’s Australia’s most powerful tourism alliance. When you connect
with us, you’re joining forces with every National, State and Territory tourism body. Together, we
make sure your business is seen by more people, in more places.

About us

you make a real impact. Join us today to build a brighter future for your business, your region, and
Australian tourism as a whole.

Join us today

## About Us

Beach Hut, inc. is a leading B2B Wholesale Distribution Center for beach and tropical themed
souvenirs. We provide custom souvenirs for not only the small Mom and Pop souvenirs shop but Big Box
Stores across the southeast region of the United States.


Beach Hut, inc. is a family-owned souvenir business. We have been in operation for over 50 years and
have been in the state of Florida since the early 1990’s.  We have grown from a small company
selling postcards to a multimillion-dollar company offering a diverse and ever-changing variety of
products.


The key to our success is the emphasis we place on vendor-employee-client relationships as well as
establishing a positive work environment for our team and satisfaction for our clients.

 

Our sales staff is a dedicated team of professionals that are committed to providing our clients
with the highest degree of customer service. Beach Hut, Inc. prides itself on giving our clients the
treatment they deserve.

 

As a distribution center our multiple warehouses are constantly stocked with the latest trends in
souvenirs. Our warehouse employees ensure orders are fulfilled and delivered in a timely fashion.

## [Welcome to Beach Travel][26]

Your Luxury Beach Getaways, Vacation, & Romance Travel Specialists

[Contact Us Today][27]

## [Destination Weddings][28]

Are you dreaming of a wedding on a beautiful beach at sunset? Or maybe an intimate ceremony beneath
a canopy of palm trees? No matter what your vision for your special day, our experts have the
knowledge, experience, and relationships to make it a reality.

[Contact Us Today][29]

## [Honeymoons][30]

When it comes to planning the perfect honeymoon, we’ve got you covered. Our experts have planned
some of the most beautiful experiences for couples for over 20 years. We can guide you from the
inspiration phase all the way to what to wear to the airport. We can make your dream honeymoon come
true.

[Contact Us Today][31]

## [Renewing Your Vows][32]

Whether it’s been a year, a decade or more, there’s nothing more romantic than renewing your vows in
a beautiful new destination or going back to where it all began. We can help with every last detail,
from choosing a venue to managing your guests. No matter what your style, we can make the most of it
and help you celebrate in style.

[Contact Us Today][33]

## [Family Vacations][34]

Even though we specialize in romance travel, our clients usually stay with us for life – and that
means providing them with the same level of service, care, and creativity when it comes to family
travel. We’ve got a world of options and opportunities to create an experience that will provide
lifelong memories for all.

[Contact Us Today][35]

### Beach Travel has been creating incredible beach vacation & romance travel packages for over 25
### years.

We specialize in Beach Vacations, Romance Vacations, Destination Weddings, Vow Renewals, Honeymoons,
Family Travel and Group Travel. We have worked with thousands of people to make their beach &

must for nature enthusiasts. Langkawi is also a duty-free island – the perfect retreat for savvy
shoppers.

### [PRIVATE TOURS][63][[Private nature tour]][64]

We can organise a private tour for you and your group in and around Auckland and as far afield as
Rotorua, Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves With 42 years of experience we can arrange a private tour for
any size of group, from individuals, couples, families to large groups. If you are spending a few
days in Auckland we can arrange a varied itinerary for you over those days.

## Why choose us?

We have been operating for 42 years and are the longest-running eco tour company in New Zealand. We
are a Net Carbon Zero certified company who have won many awards including Best Small Tourism
Company in New Zealand. Bush and Beach is a small family owned company who are leaders in
sustainable tourism and are proud of our sustainability commitment which you can find [here][66].
Some of the money from your booking goes straight back into local environmental initiatives.

With our small group tour sizes and knowledgeable and experienced guides you will have plenty of
opportunities to ask questions and find out what you want to know. We will look after you in our
small comfortable air conditioned vehicles with plenty of legroom.

Free Cancellation policy – You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the booked tour for a full
refund – [learn more][67]

Our office staff can help you with any [enquiries][68] you might have and help you choose the tour
that’s right for you. We will reconfirm all tours with you the day before so you don’t  have to
worry about pick up times.  Bush and Beach work closely with the Auckland hotels and offer **pick up
and drop offs from your Auckland City Centre hotel** for all of our Auckland day tours.

Exceptional Experiences by Exceptional People

A global leader in experiential tourism and resort services.

Meet RED Hospitality & Leisure

RED Hospitality & Leisure is a global leader in Resort, Eco- Tourism and Destination Services and
operator of world-class watersports brands across the Caribbean, South Florida and Hawaii.

[Contact us ][17]
[DJI_20230915101534_0389_D.jpg]

R

### Resort Services

RED provides critical guest facing services and outsourcing to luxury and lifestyle resorts
including concierge, beach and pool desk service, non-motorized watersports, marina management,
ground transportation, ferry services and boutique retail

[Grace-Bay-Club-221.jpg]

E

### Ecotourism

RED owns and operates world-class watersports and excursion brands across its markets and seamlessly
integrates them with our resort and cruise partners. RED sets the global standard offering unique,
high quality and safe experiences across our fleet

[_MG_6018.jpg]

D

### Destination Services

RED counts some of the worlds best hospitality brands among its customer and has the privilege of
serving as the on-property DMC to several luxury resorts and destination. RED's unique, vertically
integrated approach allows us to provide in-house, turn-key solutions to groups of all sizes and
needs with an unprecedented level of service and customer accountability

## R

## Resort Services

[Watersports & Recreation.jpg]

Watersports & Recreation

Premium non-motorized watersports, sailing lessons and onsite equipment rentals.

[DJI_20230716125817_0123_D.jpg]

Full-Service Beach Operations

Turn-key beach management, staffing and guest activation programs.

[IMG_6917.jpg]

Concierge & Experience Desks

On-property concierge support promoting curated excursions for partners like The Ritz-Carlton,
Westin, Grace Bay Club and others.

[Copy of IMG_6871.jpg]

Transportation & Ferry Services

Seamless VIP ground transfers and inter-island ferry operations.

## E

## Eco-Tourism

Brands

## "Welcome to the dream, Welcome to Italia"

Discover Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily: three extraordinary destinations where the sea meets
history, authentic flavors, and dreamlike landscapes. From pristine beaches to crystal-clear waters,
from charming villages to the most authentic traditions, every corner of Italy offers unique
emotions and unforgettable moments. Let yourself be captivated by the warmth of hospitality, the
aromas of Mediterranean cuisine, and the magic of timeless lands. Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily
await you for an authentic, intense, and surprising experience.

# Katathani Phuket Beach Resort

Kata Noi Beach, Phuket, Thailand

Welcome to Katathani Phuket Beach Resort, a deluxe beachfront sanctuary set along an 850-meter
stretch of pristine white sand on Kata Noi Beach, Phuket, Thailand. Nestled where lush green hills
gracefully embrace the sparkling blue ocean, the resort radiates tranquility and natural
beauty-perfectly embodying the spirit of Phuket.

Designed to ensure your perfect experience, the resort offers distinct wings tailored to every
traveler - whether you're venturing solo, seeking a romantic escape, or planning a family getaway.
This exquisite Phuket retreat provides everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Immerse
yourself in world-class amenities, rejuvenate with soothing spa treatments, and savor exquisite
dining options, all while basking in the serene allure of Phuket’s most idyllic settings along a
stunning public beach.

Vhari Wing Bhuri Wing

# [Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa][16]

**Welcome to Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa**

Surround yourself with nature and at this tranquil retreat in north Phuket and appreciate the real
beauty of this paradise island away from the bustling tourist crowds. Situated on the fringes of
Sirinat National Park there is an abundance of greenery area, and the beautiful beach with gently
sloping white sand is just a few steps away.

**Nai Yang Beach Resort** is located in a quiet bay on the northwest coast of Phuket Island. Guests
can enjoy comfortable rooms, a spa center, and an outdoor swimming pool. The rooms offer beautiful
views of the tropical landscape. Free parking is available for guests.

Nai Yang Beach Resort is only 1 km from Phuket International Airport. It takes no more than 5
minutes to walk to the sandy beaches.

The rooms at Nai Yang Resort are decorated in a modern style and equipped with air conditioning.
Each room has a private balcony overlooking the lush garden and the pool. Other standard amenities
include tea/coffee making facilities and a cable TV.

The tour desk can assist guests in booking one-day island excursions. Laundry services are also
available.

At **Turtle Bay Restaurant**, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring international cuisine,
while **The Sand Restaurant** offers a variety of Thai and Western dishes.

sloping white sand is just a few steps away.

**Nai Yang Beach Resort** is located in a quiet bay on the northwest coast of Phuket Island. Guests
can enjoy comfortable rooms, a spa center, and an outdoor swimming pool. The rooms offer beautiful
views of the tropical landscape. Free parking is available for guests.

Nai Yang Beach Resort is only 1 km from Phuket International Airport. It takes no more than 5
minutes to walk to the sandy beaches.

The rooms at Nai Yang Resort are decorated in a modern style and equipped with air conditioning.
Each room has a private balcony overlooking the lush garden and the pool. Other standard amenities
include tea/coffee making facilities and a cable TV.

The tour desk can assist guests in booking one-day island excursions. Laundry services are also
available.

At **Turtle Bay Restaurant**, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring international cuisine,
while **The Sand Restaurant** offers a variety of Thai and Western dishes.

## FROM TIMES SQUARE TO THE WORLD

Our video series follows New Yorkers around the boroughs as they uncover NYC's groundbreaking
cultural movements, creative cuisines and revolutionary ideas—starting right from Times Square. See
the trailer below, and

[**watch the full series here**][7]

## ABOUT THE FIVE BOROUGHS

[EXPLORE THE BOROUGHS][8]

So what’s a “borough,” anyway? It’s like a smaller city within our massive metropolis. New York City
has five of them.

### Staten Island

New York City’s southernmost borough is filled with historic attractions, beach views and global
dining options—all just a ferry ride away.

[View Borough][9]

### The Bronx

The Bronx is packed with New York City history and culture. It’s where Babe Ruth became a baseball
legend, where the sounds and styles of hip-hop were born and where you can feast on old-world
classics in its own Little Italy.

[View Borough][10]

### Brooklyn

Between its world-class nightlife and boundary-pushing cuisine, Brooklyn has earned an enviable
reputation, but make no mistake—there's fun to be had for all ages.

[View Borough][11]

### Manhattan

From the bright lights of Broadway to the soaring elms of Central Park and beyond, Manhattan is an
American icon. With the most recognizable skyline in the world, NYC’s most visited borough is full
of excitement for every kind of adventurer.

[View Borough][12]

### Queens

Queens can satisfy nearly every taste and thrill. From an endless selection of old-world cuisines to
the scenic surf, it’s easy to explore the entire world in one trip around this borough.

[View Borough][13]

# Home

## We’re On the Beach

On the Beach Group plc is one of the UK’s largest online package holiday specialists. We offer
choice, value, flexibility and financial protection, powered by our proprietary technology platform.

With an asset-light, cash-generative model, we drive customer acquisition and loyalty through
scalable technology, automation and operational efficiency, enabling us to grow profitably while
helping more people holiday better and more often.

Renowned for beach package holidays, we have leveraged our expertise, technology and strong supplier
relationships to broaden our addressable market, expanding into city breaks and cruise holidays, and
offering our full range of holidays to customers in the Republic of Ireland.

# Home

## We’re On the Beach

On the Beach Group plc is one of the UK’s largest online package holiday specialists. We offer
choice, value, flexibility and financial protection, powered by our proprietary technology platform.

With an asset-light, cash-generative model, we drive customer acquisition and loyalty through
scalable technology, automation and operational efficiency, enabling us to grow profitably while
helping more people holiday better and more often.

Renowned for beach package holidays, we have leveraged our expertise, technology and strong supplier
relationships to broaden our addressable market, expanding into city breaks and cruise holidays, and
offering our full range of holidays to customers in the Republic of Ireland.

##### About Rassada Pier

**Rassada Pier** is a passenger pier located in [ Rassada Subdistrict][13], [Mueang Phuket
District][14] [ Phuket Province.][15] It serves as a central hub for ferry services,
[speedboats][16], and [ferries][17] connecting the main island of Phuket with various islands in the
[ Andaman Sea ][18], such as [Phi Phi Islands][19], [Koh Lanta ][20], [Ao Nang ][21], [Koh
Lipe][22], and other islands.

### 🤝 Concession and Management

In 2001, the [Phuket Provincial Administrative Organization][23] granted a 30-year concession to
**[Sea Tran Travel Company Limited][24] ** to manage, operate, and develop the facilities at Rassada
Pier. During that period, usage increased significantly to improve operational efficiency, enhance
safety standards, and improve services for tourists. The concession will expire in 2031, after which
it will be reviewed or extended based on operational results and public policy.

[Location view]

## 📜 History

#### Before 2000: Local Boat Dock

Before developing into a maritime transportation hub, Rassada Pier was merely a small dock used for
fishing boats and local cargo vessels. The area was just an ordinary coastline with minimal
infrastructure, supporting fishermen and traders between islands.

#### 2001–2002: Initial Development

Local authorities collaborated with ferry operators to officially develop the area into a pier.

#### 2005–2010: Expansion

Construction of concrete piers, passenger buildings, and the start of ferry services to [Phi Phi
Islands ][25] and other islands.

#### 2010–2015: Tourism Integration

Rassada Pier was incorporated into tour packages and travel connections with hotels, with route
expansions to [Koh Lanta][26] and [Railay Beach][27].

#### 2016–2019: Technology and Management

Introduction of computerized ticketing systems and more systematic transportation management.

#### 2020–2021: COVID-19 Impact

The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in the suspension of most ferry services, with tourist numbers
dramatically declining.

#### 2022–Present: Recovery

After the country reopened, Rassada Pier resumed normal operations with minor repairs and
improvements to infrastructure, continuing to serve as Phuket's main transportation hub.

## 🏛️ Administration and Management

[ Rassada Pier][28] is located in [Rassada Subdistrict][29], one of eight subdistricts in [Mueang
Phuket District][30], Phuket Province, Thailand. Rassada Subdistrict has the status of a subdistrict
municipality, which performs local administrative functions within the framework of Phuket Province.

The pier is under the responsibility of the **[Rassada Subdistrict Administrative
Organization][31]**, which oversees infrastructure, cleanliness, and community development in the
area. Although some pier operations and maintenance are the responsibility of private ferry
companies, facilities and connecting roads remain under joint supervision with local authorities.

### Supervising Agencies

Due to its economic and tourism importance, the pier is supervised by provincial tourism and
transportation agencies, including:
* **[Phuket Harbor Office][32]**
* **[Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT)][33]** - Phuket Office
* **[Phuket Provincial Land Transport Office][34]**

## 🏗️ Pier Components

### 🅿️ Parking Area

Rassada Pier has parking systems for both cars and motorcycles, offering daily and overnight
parking. Services include both open-air and covered parking with adequate space for users.

##### About Rassada Pier

**Rassada Pier** is a passenger pier located in [ Rassada Subdistrict][13], [Mueang Phuket
District][14] [ Phuket Province.][15] It serves as a central hub for ferry services,
[speedboats][16], and [ferries][17] connecting the main island of Phuket with various islands in the
[ Andaman Sea ][18], such as [Phi Phi Islands][19], [Koh Lanta ][20], [Ao Nang ][21], [Koh
Lipe][22], and other islands.

### 🤝 Concession and Management

In 2001, the [Phuket Provincial Administrative Organization][23] granted a 30-year concession to
**[Sea Tran Travel Company Limited][24] ** to manage, operate, and develop the facilities at Rassada
Pier. During that period, usage increased significantly to improve operational efficiency, enhance
safety standards, and improve services for tourists. The concession will expire in 2031, after which
it will be reviewed or extended based on operational results and public policy.

[Location view]

## 📜 History

#### Before 2000: Local Boat Dock

Before developing into a maritime transportation hub, Rassada Pier was merely a small dock used for
fishing boats and local cargo vessels. The area was just an ordinary coastline with minimal
infrastructure, supporting fishermen and traders between islands.

#### 2001–2002: Initial Development

Local authorities collaborated with ferry operators to officially develop the area into a pier.

#### 2005–2010: Expansion

Construction of concrete piers, passenger buildings, and the start of ferry services to [Phi Phi
Islands ][25] and other islands.

#### 2010–2015: Tourism Integration

Rassada Pier was incorporated into tour packages and travel connections with hotels, with route
expansions to [Koh Lanta][26] and [Railay Beach][27].

#### 2016–2019: Technology and Management

Introduction of computerized ticketing systems and more systematic transportation management.

#### 2020–2021: COVID-19 Impact

The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in the suspension of most ferry services, with tourist numbers
dramatically declining.

#### 2022–Present: Recovery

After the country reopened, Rassada Pier resumed normal operations with minor repairs and
improvements to infrastructure, continuing to serve as Phuket's main transportation hub.

## 🏛️ Administration and Management

[ Rassada Pier][28] is located in [Rassada Subdistrict][29], one of eight subdistricts in [Mueang
Phuket District][30], Phuket Province, Thailand. Rassada Subdistrict has the status of a subdistrict
municipality, which performs local administrative functions within the framework of Phuket Province.

The pier is under the responsibility of the **[Rassada Subdistrict Administrative
Organization][31]**, which oversees infrastructure, cleanliness, and community development in the
area. Although some pier operations and maintenance are the responsibility of private ferry
companies, facilities and connecting roads remain under joint supervision with local authorities.

### Supervising Agencies

Due to its economic and tourism importance, the pier is supervised by provincial tourism and
transportation agencies, including:
* **[Phuket Harbor Office][32]**
* **[Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT)][33]** - Phuket Office
* **[Phuket Provincial Land Transport Office][34]**

## 🏗️ Pier Components

### 🅿️ Parking Area

Rassada Pier has parking systems for both cars and motorcycles, offering daily and overnight
parking. Services include both open-air and covered parking with adequate space for users.

### 🚐 Pick-up/Drop-off Point

The pier has designated areas for tourist vans, taxis, and private cars for convenient passenger
pick-up and drop-off.

### 🚕 Common Transportation Methods
* **[Taxi][35]** – Easily found in Phuket, suitable for busy periods, but should be booked in
  advance during high tourist season.
* **[Vans][36]** – Arranged by hotels or tour companies, often included in ferry packages.
* **[Motorcycle Taxis][37]** – Suitable for short trips, such as from downtown or nearby hotels.
* **[Songthaew (Two-rows)][38]** – A cost-effective alternative but takes longer.
* **[PPA Smart Bus][39]** – An economical option, but this bus operates only during certain hours.

## 🌊 Popular Destinations

Rassada Pier serves as the main departure point for ferries to:
* [Phi Phi Islands][40]
* [Koh Lanta][41]
* [Railay Beach (Ao Nang)][42]
* [Koh Lipe][43]
* Other Andaman Sea islands

##### Map & Directions

###### How to get here:
* **By Car:** Use GPS and search for "Rassada Pier". Parking is available on-site.
* **By Public Transport:** Take a local taxi or minivan from Phuket Town (about 15 minutes).
* **By Bus:** From Phuket Bus Terminal, you can take a tuk-tuk or taxi directly.

### Accommodation

Rhapsody Resort offers stylish self-contained accommodation in Surfers Paradise. Guests can choose
between studio, one, or two-bedroom apartments with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and city
skyline. Each apartment includes a full kitchen and laundry facilities for added convenience.

### Facilities

The hotel includes a rooftop garden terrace on Level 41, providing panoramic views of the Gold
Coast. A 20-metre heated outdoor swimming pool, spa, steam room, and sauna are available to guests
for relaxation. A fully equipped gym on Level 27 offers scenic views during workouts.

### Dining Options

The Rhapsody Beachside Café on the ground level serves organic fair trade coffee and a varied menu
featuring fresh seasonal dishes. Guests can enjoy casual dining just steps from Surfers Paradise
Beach. Outdoor BBQ facilities are available for guests wishing to cook and dine al fresco.

### Location

Situated just 100 metres from patrolled Surfers Paradise Beach, Rhapsody Resort is in close
proximity to local restaurants and retail options. The hotel is an ideal base for exploring the Gold
Coast and its many attractions, including theme parks and hidden beachfronts. Public transport is
easily accessible, enhancing convenience for guests.

### Event Spaces

The hotel offers two meeting rooms on Level 27, suitable for small corporate events and gatherings.
Both spaces feature modern amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi and adjoining balcony access with
ocean views. These rooms can accommodate groups ranging from 6 to 50 guests.

Dining: Rhapsody Beachside Café

Welcome to San Juan, the capital city of **[Puerto Rico][73]**, where Old World elegance, modern
luxuries, and tropical allure come together to offer unforgettable experiences like no other
destination.   Swim, [snorkel][74], surf, and relax at [San Juan’s beaches][75], explore the
historic and romantic district of [Old San Juan][76], and immerse yourself in the vibrant
[culture][77].  Whether you’re honeymooning, a solo traveler, a young family, or young at heart, San
Juan will deliver extraordinary experiences.

Go on a number of exciting [day trips from San Juan][78], such as exploring the [*El Yunque
Rainforest*][79], seeing the magic of the [bioluminescent bays][80], [sailing to secluded
islands][81], beach hopping to stunning beaches, exploring world-class [caves][82], going on[
off-road adventures][83], [ziplining][84], and much more.

visitors; you’ll feel like you’re in a European city, but more intimate, colorful, and certainly
livelier.  We invite you to make Old San Juan your first stop in Puerto Rico.  Wear comfortable
shoes; you’ll

### Read more

… want to walk every block leading to five-century-old forts, museums, cathedrals, elegant squares,
romantic promenades, delightful restaurants, and one-of-a-kind shops.  Immerse yourself in our
vibrant culture by joining the festive events celebrated throughout the year.  For honeymooners, the
Old City unfolds romantic experiences and quiet spots to cherish moments of love. Get lost in the
allure of this historic gem and create memories that linger in the heart.

[About Old San Juan][87] ⎮ [Hotels in Old San Juan][88] ⎮ [Old San Juan Tours][89]

## Tourism in San Juan, Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico 2023 - Tourism Guide]

Five centuries ago, San Juan was an impenetrable walled city; today, it is a hassle-free and
exciting tropical escape in the Caribbean, welcoming visitors with open arms.  San Juan is the most
popular tourist destination in Puerto Rico and a bustling cruise port in the Caribbean, giving
visitors world-class attractions, fun activities, and rich cultural experiences easily accessible,
so no precious vacation time is wasted.  

[Getting around San Juan][91] to enjoy it all is easy; no car rental is needed; you can walk to many
places, take a taxi or Uber, or enjoy scenic bicycle rides around the city.

### + Key Facts for Visitors
* If you’re a U.S. Citizen, there is no passport requirement; it is like traveling to another
  state. 
* There is no need to travel far; the average flight from many US city airports is just 3.5 hours. 
* Spanish and English are the official languages, and most of the staff in the tourism industry are
  bilingual. 
* No car rental is needed to explore and enjoy the city of San Juan. 
* Outside of the city, you can explore the natural wonders and fun things to do around the island;
  visitors can book tours with friendly professional guides or rent a car to explore at their own
  pace. 

This travel guide includes everything you need to help plan an extraordinary vacation.  Sit back,
relax, keep this page open, and begin your adventure in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
